run: HSL_AUTOPLAY_BRAIN=lookahead HSL_AUTOPLAY_DEBUG_AI=1 HSL_AUTOPLAY_LEVELS=<shard> tools/godot.sh --headless --fixed-fps 60 --script res://tests/run_autoplay_sweep_tests.gd, shards of 1-24 battles in campaign order, every battle booted standalone with the opening party (no chapter growth); read from the STEP_DBG trace: first_friendly_death_round counts player-side units only (the battle's playable party and friendly NPCs); defeat_unit is the scenario's player_unit_id when the lead unit fell, otherwise the unit the fail clause names (the player-side unit whose fall ended the battle); defeat_same_hit lists the player-side units downed by the same hit; by=counter when the unit fell to a counter on its own action. handoff_replay: HSL_AUTOPLAY_HANDOFF=<playtest kit>/snapshots/<NNNN>.json HSL_AUTOPLAY_BRAIN=lookahead HSL_AUTOPLAY_DEBUG_AI=1 tools/godot.sh --headless --fixed-fps 60 --script res://tests/run_autoplay_sweep_tests.gd, stopped once round 4 began; the snapshot is the chapter walk hand-off saved just before this battle (tools/hsl_playtest_kit.py generate --force-win, not tracked)
note: Snapshot of 2026-09-30; the greedy fields follow results.json and are replaced by it when the two disagree. Exploration driver (tests/support/AutoplayBrain.gd lookahead) over the remake rules with the loop RNG seeded; not evidence about original balance, and a standalone battle is not the chapter walk's difficulty (the walk arrives with a grown party). cause: hero_down = the lead unit (player_unit_id) fell; must_survive_down = another unit the fail clause names fell; rule_suspect = fails in round 1–2 in a way that does not read as difficulty and still does with the walk hand-off party, not yet checked against the original (see note and handoff_replay); hard = a rule_suspect battle that the original referee (tools/hsltools/probes/_enemy_level.py batch, players waiting) plays with the same enemy reach and damage scale over rounds 1–2, so the loss is the battle's difficulty (see note); rule_gap:<id> = the referee shows a divergence recorded in parity_gap_inventory under <id>; underleveled_standalone = fails in round 1–2 standalone but not with the walk hand-off party (opening party against a later battle); driver_stalemate = dead_end from the driver holding position; unfinished = not played to an outcome.

summary.caveat: The three sources come from different rules versions (brain_comparison.json 2026-09-26, results.json 2026-09-29, this lookahead run 2026-09-30), so the flip lists and single contrasts such as LEVEL002 (lookahead fail where scored won) and LEVEL528 (greedy win, lookahead fail) are leads to check, not conclusions about the drivers.

59.note: greedy and lookahead fail in the same round (scored not run): 雷歐納德 falls to actor060_1 (地劫神) in the second enemy phase; with the walk hand-off party (handoff_replay) 地劫神 takes him from 163 HP to 0 in one entry. WINFAIL059 has no scripted defeat: fail is 雷歐納德 dead, and actSetPlayerUndead targets 地劫神 at low HP inside the win section. Original referee (_enemy_level.py batch --align --mix 20, players waiting, template party): on the default board (--levels 59 --seeds 1,2,3 --turns 2) 地劫神 (3×3 body at [40,16], move_point 0, weapon item 55 action_twice) waits both rounds on both sides. The original writes one row per action_twice entry (both actions, one HP total), the remake one row per action, so a single remake action is not compared with an original row; entry totals differ by up to about three times, in either direction (雷歐納德 at 999 HP, round 1, seed 1: [40,18] original 716 against remake 223, [40,21] original 409 against remake 454 + 437). Reach probe over cells two to five from the centre (雷歐納德 999 HP, seed 1): at [40,20] and [36,16] the original stops at eip 0x4603ca while casting and gives no reading, not compared. Supported: every damaging entry on both sides is lethal to 163 HP, so the loss is of the same nature on both sides. Former rule gap: with 雷歐納德 five cells from the centre ([40,21], [37,19], [35,16]; seeds 1–8, two rounds; 45 original rounds read, 2 stopped at 0x4603ca) the original falls to the ordinary attack after a missed spell 26 times (0x43ff32 roll above 10 → 0x440041, then 0x409090 weapon check and 0x40d8b0 station search) and never strikes, while the remake struck 14 times before the port (11 of them after AIDecisionRules.side_walk_roll); the exit is the move-0 branch: 0x40d8b0 floods with radius live+0x12c = 0, 0x40f200 returns at 0x40f24b without writing the centre cell, 0x413390 collects nothing, and 0x440094 sends the turn to 0x441eb8. The five-cell normal attack now matches (AINavigationRules.attack_stations empty at move 0, BattleLoopAI._ai_offense ends the turn with wait_reason immobile_no_station): five-cell normal attacks 14 → 0, two-to-four-cell 5 → 0, and the injected in-body cells no longer draw a normal attack. The spell miss rate still differs: at the same five-cell probes the original misses 32 times against the remake's 11 (seeds 1–8 × three cells), and the only whole-round damage pair is seed 1 round 1 (409 against 423); recorded as boss-twice-action-spell-miss-rate (oracle_batch README). The loss does not move: lookahead from the initial party fails in round 2 (雷歐納德 down to actor060_1), handoff snapshot 0194 fails in round 2 (163 → 0 in one entry), greedy fails in round 2.
